components.name: Menu Filter
components.css: .ds-filters{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;padding:12px 0;background:var(--paper,#f6f2e7);border-block:1px solid #c8c1b4}.ds-filters button{min-height:44px;padding:8px 20px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:100px;background:transparent;color:var(--ink,#191715);font:700 .9rem var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif);cursor:pointer}.ds-filters button[aria-pressed=true]{background:var(--ink,#191715);color:var(--paper,#f6f2e7)}.ds-filters button:hover:not([aria-pressed=true]){border-color:#c8c1b4}.ds-filters button:focus-visible{outline:3px solid currentColor;outline-offset:5px}

components.name: Review Field
components.description: A labeled name field from the guest review form.
components.html: <label class="ds-field">Prénom<input type="text" name="name" autocomplete="given-name" maxlength="40" required></label>
components.css: .ds-field{display:grid;gap:.4rem;background:var(--paper,#f6f2e7);color:var(--ink,#191715);font:750 .88rem var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif)}.ds-field input{width:100%;min-height:44px;box-sizing:border-box;padding:.65rem .8rem;border:1px solid #83786a;border-radius:6px;background:transparent;color:inherit;font:400 1rem/1.4 var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif)}.ds-field input:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #b8330e;outline-offset:4px}

components.name: Menu Row
components.description: A dish and its indicative price aligned across a fine rule.
components.css: .ds-menu{margin:0;background:var(--paper,#f6f2e7);color:var(--ink,#191715)}.ds-menu>div{display:flex;align-items:baseline;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;border-bottom:1px solid #c8c1b4;padding:22px 0}.ds-menu dt,.ds-menu dd{margin:0;font:600 2.2rem/1 var(--display,'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif)}.ds-menu dd{white-space:nowrap;font-weight:700;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-menu abbr{font:700 .68rem/1 var(--body,'DM Sans',sans-serif);text-decoration:none}

narrative.overview: Large condensed lettering, vivid orange, a floating burger, a yellow stamp, and a handwritten annotation establish the confirmed poster character. Warm paper and aligned menu rows carry practical information.
keyCharacteristics: Condensed uppercase display type with readable sans-serif details
dos: Do preserve the confirmed poster character.
Do retain visible keyboard focus, responsive reflow and reduced-motion behavior.
Do keep asset provenance identifiable in project records.
donts: Don't present indicative prices, dated ratings or generated imagery as newly verified restaurant facts.
